subject: general
question:
Identify the correct label for the following.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e77f7003f7af4c3b39bb11b5931397ef738371e7b12a6e3a9e1cf2c1aa02af57.png]

options.text: A - Stigma; B - Style; C - Sepal
A - Stigma; B - Style; C - Ovary
A - Anther; B - Style; C - Ovary
A - Anther; B - Filament; C - Ovary

solution:
The correct answer is __**A - Stigma; B - Style; C - Ovary.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The structure in the image has a** long, slender shape with a slight curve**, which is characteristic of a style in a flower.
 
• The** style **is the part of the flower that connects the **stigma **(where pollen is received) to the** ovary **(where seeds are formed).
 
• Stigma is typically a** smaller, more rounded **structure at the top of the style.
 
• Stigma is the** topmost** part of the female reproductive structure in a flower, where **pollen is received **and** germinated.**
 
• **Ovary** is the enlarged part of the female reproductive structure at the **base of the flower**, where the **ovules** (future seeds) are housed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sepal **are usually **green, leaf-like** structures that protect the** flower bud **before it blooms.
 
• **Anther **is the part of the **male reproductive structure **in a flower that produces and **releases pollen**.
 
• **Filament** is the **long, thin stalk** that supports the anther in the male reproductive structure of a flower.
 
• The male reproductive organ in flowers is called the** stamen, or androecium.**
 
 
• It is made up of **stamens.**
 
• Stamens create **pollen **in terminal sac-like structures called anthers.
 
• Normally, the anthers are located near the end of the stamen, which is a** long, thin stalk.**
